narrative_sections.heading: Turning points
narrative_sections.body: The biography reads turning points only from the chronology already attached to TSMC Arizona campus. Phoenix and TSMC wastewater agreement enters the named project trail is retained at 2026-07-22 on the basis "FTFN capture date for the official May 2026 agreement." Its ledger moves from "Regional and provider water context without a named project delivery instrument" to "Project-specific wastewater conveyance agreement with later reclaimed-water milestones" and names city agreement authorizing bounded conveyance improvements and milestone conditions as the artifact. The governing limit remains: An agreement is not completed, accepted, or operating wastewater or reclaimed-water infrastructure. Phoenix records differentiated Fab 1, Fab 2, and Fab 3 stages is retained at 2026-07-22 on the basis "FTFN capture date for the July 2026 City release." Its ledger moves from "Physical campus buildout without one current facility-stage account" to "Bounded production claim for Fab 1, construction completion for Fab 2, and structural progress for Fab 3" and names city release describing facility-specific milestones as the artifact. The governing limit remains: One City statement does not establish accepted service, customer qualification, compatible repeated output, or a common campus stage. These entries are not merged into a smooth progress story. Each event or Published signal keeps its own entity, date, authority, and claim scope. A financing record may clarify commitment without proving construction; a physical milestone may clarify implementation without proving validation; a test may clarify validation without proving acceptance or recurring operation. GAO's June 2025 table lists 30 Base at a $1.864 billion baseline and August 2030 completion date, while the definition-phase 30 Reliable current cost and completion date remained to be determined. narrative_sections.body: The public chronology for Florida Space Coast Launch Corridor is a place evidence shelf rather than a single project timeline. Commercial launch operators complete the FAA Part 450 transition (signal-faa-part450-operator-transition) says: The FAA reported in March 2026 that commercial launch and reentry operators had transitioned to the Part 450 licensing framework by the statutory deadline, creating a common regulatory layer without proving any particular mission or site's readiness. FAA completes the LC-39A Starship environmental decision (signal-faa-starship-lc39a-environmental-decision) says: FAA's January 2026 Record of Decision completes the environmental-review stage for the selected Starship-Super Heavy alternative at LC-39A while explicitly leaving vehicle operator licensing, safety, risk, and financial-responsibility requirements open. Kennedy's master plan frames a multi-user infrastructure conversion stack (signal-kennedy-multiuser-master-plan) says: NASA's June 2026 Kennedy Space Center master-plan update organizes long-range land, facility, utility, transportation, and multi-user development, while leaving funding, project authorization, construction, acceptance, and utilization to separate records. Kennedy demonstrates prescribed burns during an active launch countdown (signal-ksc-active-countdown-prescribed-burn) says: NASA and the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service conducted two prescribed burns totaling about 2,600 acres during an active Kennedy launch countdown in January 2026, coordinating habitat, weather, access, personnel, and mission operations. Kennedy's replacement causeway bridge is fully operational (signal-ksc-causeway-bridge-operational) says: NASA records the primary access bridge serving Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station as fully operational after the westbound span opened March 18, 2025.
